brief:
A prolonged water crisis has gripped the rural area of Masafer Yatta in the West Bank, the Palestine News Network reported. Water tanker drivers continue traveling between scattered communities to deliver much-needed supplies despite dangerous conditions and multiple obstacles that threaten their routes through the region.

The drivers maintain these critical supply lines to reach communities facing acute water shortages. They navigate hazardous terrain and other risks inherent to conditions affecting the drought-hit area, working to ensure residents receive access to water amid the ongoing crisis that has left many settlements without reliable sources.
